p1.text: You've put AI agents on Kubernetes. They can read logs, check rollouts, and find the cause.
p1.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] You've put AI agents on Kubernetes. They can read logs, check rollouts, and find the cause.

p2.text: But they sit behind a prompt, away from where your team works.
p2.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] But they sit behind a prompt, away from where your team works.

p3.text: Alerts and questions land in team chat. Putting your agent there means building threads, streaming and questions yourself.
p3.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Alerts and questions land in team chat. Putting your agent there means building threads, streaming and questions yourself.

reveal.text: Introducing Agent Kourier: a Kubernetes-native broker between team chat and streaming A2A agents.
reveal.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Introducing Agent Courier: a Kubernetes-native broker between team chat and streaming A-to-A agents.

promise.text: An alert, or a question, becomes an agent session in its own thread.
promise.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] An alert, or a question, becomes an agent session in its own thread.

r1.text: Your alerts arrive in the channel as they always have. Agent Kourier reads each one and hands it to your agent. The agent investigates under the alert, step by step.
r1.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Your alerts arrive in the channel as they always have. Agent Courier reads each one and hands it to your agent. The agent investigates under the alert, step by step.

r2.text: Reply in the thread, and the session continues with everything it already found.
r2.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] Reply in the thread, and the session continues with everything it already found.

r3.text: No alert? Mention Agent Kourier and ask.
r3.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] No alert? Mention Agent Courier and ask.

r4.text: When the agent needs a decision, it asks, and waits for your answer.
r4.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] When the agent needs a decision, it asks, and waits for your answer.

yaml.text: A team applies a Binding next to its agent. The agent needs no chat code.
yaml.say: [confident, measured, authoritative] A team applies a Binding next to its agent. The agent needs no chat code.

close.text: Agent Kourier works with kagent, or any A2A agent that streams. It keeps a session per thread, streams the reply, and carries the agent's questions and your answers. Slack is supported; Microsoft Teams and webhooks are experimental. Agent Kourier. Write the agent, not the chat integration.

t-problem.text: Your agent is ready. The chat integration is another project.

t-proof.text: Alerts and questions become agent sessions in Slack, and in Microsoft Teams as an experiment.

teams.text: In Microsoft Teams, the agent works the alert step by step too. Teams support is experimental.
